name: Cryogenic van der Pauw Hall analysis in an LN2 bath at nominal 0.75 T (FastHall documented method class)
plain_name: Measure carrier type, density and mobility in a cold semiconductor
description: Measure carrier type, density and mobility in a cold semiconductor. A bounded, source-grounded procedure profile; compatibility covers the listed checks and does not guarantee measured scientific performance.

sources.citation: Lake Shore: MeasureReady FastHall Station catalog, revision 062526

requirements.rationale: The measurement requires Hall sourcing, voltage readout, switching and analysis. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.
Use the explicitly documented flooded-LN2 sample environment. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

Select the manufacturer's nominal 0.75 T LN2 setup; this is not a universal minimum Hall field. These are this profile's reviewed procedure conditions, not a universal requirement for the scientific field.

missing_information: This is a manufacturer-documented measurement method, not a single published material dataset.
Specimen temperature must be measured; the bath's nominal boiling point is not treated as a guaranteed sample setpoint.
Sample dimensions/thickness, ohmic-contact quality and excitation current must be confirmed. No mobility or carrier density is invented.
confirmation_note: Profile author reviewed these exact sourced conditions on 2026-10-31. The application must still require the user's review/confirmation; all edits invalidate confirmation.
